title: Microsoft Online Services Case Study: Arctic Information Technology & Staser Consulting Group
description: Supplying the collaboration software(BPOS) for the consulting advisor to North Americas largest civil engineering project in history

asr.full_text: The Stacia Consulting Group helps our clients keep track of information for better decision-making. From very large petrochemical industry giants here in Alaska, all the way down to mom-and-pop shops. Our company is going through what I would call a quantum leap from where we are to where we're going. The Stacia Consulting Group is going to be part of North America's largest construction project in history, the natural gas pipeline. Pipeline. The challenges of our business are global. We organize and coordinate. Among 42 affiliates and to be able to get them together is difficult. Arctic Information Technology is a Microsoft Gold certified partner with offices in. Anchorage and Seattle. We employ 25 professionals providing services around. Dynamics GP, network infrastructure and Microsoft Online Services. The Stacer Group contacted Arctic IT about a year and a half ago asking for a solution to. Assist them in providing communications and a collaboration platform for their geographically. Dispersed users. We have to coordinate work across a large geographic area and the complexity of the. Tasks is huge. We're helping our clients with the permitting process of what will be North America's largest. Construction contract in history. To keep pace with the explosive development that's going on in the industry and in particular. With the natural gas pipeline. We need tools that will meet the demands of that project, and Microsoft Online Services. Is that tool. The low monthly recurring cost associated with the business productivity of the online. Suite was easily absorbed into their business plan. It took us all of 10 minutes to explain the benefits of the suite, which includes Exchange. SharePoint Online and Office Live Meeting and they bought in. We were ready to deploy immediately. The deployment of Microsoft Online Services was a snap. The integration took less than a day. With Exchange Online and email and calendaring, we've been able to collaborate more efficiently as a team. SharePoint Online is wonderful for collaboration. It is very cost-effective and efficient to get projects running more smoothly. With Microsoft Live Meeting, we've been able to reduce travel costs and being able to connect virtually with all of our team members across Alaska and the lower 48. It's been great. With Microsoft Online Services, Arctic IT is able to realize a higher margin on the professional services we deliver, along with a continued annuity stream for the sales of the product. It's going to allow us to attract new customers,. Smaller organizations, and extend. The solutions that we're able to provide. Today to our larger enterprise customers as well. Arctic IT is very excited to add. Microsoft Online Services to our portfolio of managed services.

References to monthly recurring cost, deployment, and business benefits are framed as organizational software procurement and service delivery, with no viewer payment, credential submission, or participation condition described. Interview identifiers, a consulting-group webpage, and a conference-room meeting support the workplace case-study context.
